  else h.innerHTML=`<input id="ds_v" placeholder="${f==='k'?'ISIN ya da kod (ör. TRT061228T16, AKBNK)':'Kıymet ya da ihraççı adı'}" autocomplete="off">`; }
const dsM=(x,r)=>r.f==='g'?x.g===r.q:r.f==='k'?lc(x.k).includes(lc(r.q)):lc(x.mk+' '+x.iss).includes(lc(r.q));

function dsRows(){
  const qt=dsFold(($('ds_q')||{}).value), qg=($('ds_qg')||{}).value||'', pq=!!(qt||qg), pm=x=>(!qg||x.g===qg)&&(!qt||dsFold(x.mk+' '+x.k+' '+x.iss).includes(qt)), zero=$('ds_z').checked, mode=$('ds_m').value, co=$('ds_c').value, inc=dss.rules.filter(r=>r.inc), exc=dss.rules.filter(r=>!r.inc), out=[];

    const ir=inc.filter(r=>r.f!=='kod'), m0=ir.length?its.filter(x=>ir.some(r=>dsM(x,r))):its, m=pq?m0.filter(pm):m0;
    const ms=m.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.t-a.t), labs=[...new Set(ms.map(x=>(x.k||x.g)+(x.g?' ('+x.g+')':'')))], tur=[...new Set(ms.map(x=>x.g).filter(Boolean))], isl=[...new Set(ms.map(x=>x.iss).filter(Boolean))];
    out.push({kod,fx,labs,tur,isl,nm:ms.length}); });
  return out; }

const _gtB=gtBody; gtBody=function(id){ _gtB.apply(this,arguments); if(id==='dsF') dsTurLab(); };

/* ---------- ÜST ARAMA ÇUBUĞU: fon, şirket, kıymet, ihraççı, konkordato ve ödeme takvimi birlikte ---------- */
function gsData(raw){
  const q=dsFold(raw); if(q.length<2) return null; const has=t=>dsFold(t).includes(q);
  const funds=FX.filter(f=>has(f.kod+' '+f.ad)).sort((a,b)=>b.tut1-a.tut1);
  const cos=new Map(); FX.forEach(f=>{ if(has(f.yon)){ const c=cos.get(f.yon)||{n:0,tot:0}; c.n++; c.tot+=f.tut1; cos.set(f.yon,c); } });
  const secs=[...KSEC.values()].filter(x=>has((x.k||'')+' '+x.mk+' '+x.iss)).sort((a,b)=>b.funds.size-a.funds.size||b.tut-a.tut);
  const iss=new Map(); secs.forEach(x=>{ const k=x.iss||x.mk; const c=iss.get(k)||{k,n:0,f:new Set()}; c.n++; x.funds.forEach(z=>c.f.add(z)); iss.set(k,c); });
  const kon=KTA.filter(r=>has(r[0]+' '+r[1]+' '+(r[18]||''))); const ost=AYAR.ost.filter(r=>has(r[0]+' '+(r[1]||'')));
  const hf=new Set(); secs.forEach(x=>x.funds.forEach(z=>hf.add(z)));
  return {q:raw,funds,cos:[...cos.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1].tot-a[1].tot),secs,iss:[...iss.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.f.size-a.f.size),kon,ost,hf};
}
function gsClose(){ const d=$('gs_drop'); if(d) d.style.display='none'; }
function gsRender(){
  const d=$('gs_drop'), raw=$('gs').value.trim(), r=gsData(raw);
  if(!r){ d.style.display='none'; return; }
  const sec=(t,n,body)=>body?`<div class="gsh"><span>${t}</span><span>${nf(n)}</span></div>${body}`:'';
  const it=(attr,l,sub,rt)=>`<div class="gsi" ${attr}><div><b>${l}</b>${sub?`<small>${sub}</small>`:''}</div><div class="gsr">${rt||''}</div></div>`;
  const q1=esc(raw).replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
  let h='';
  if(r.secs.length) h+=`<div class="gsall" data-gsa="ds|${q1}|">“${esc(raw)}” ile ilgili tüm ürünleri ve fonları Detaylı Arama’da aç → ${nf(r.hf.size)} fon · ${nf(r.secs.length)} kıymet</div>`;
  h+=sec('Fonlar',r.funds.length,r.funds.slice(0,5).map(f=>it(`data-flfund="${esc(f.kod)}"`,esc(f.kod)+' · '+esc(f.ad.length>58?f.ad.slice(0,58)+'…':f.ad),esc(shortCo(f.yon)),fmtTL(f.tut1))).join(''));
  h+=sec('Portföy Şirketleri',r.cos.length,r.cos.slice(0,4).map(([n,c])=>it(`data-gsa="co|${esc(n)}"`,esc(shortCo(n)),'',nf(c.n)+' fon · '+fmtTL(c.tot))).join(''));
  h+=sec('İhraççılar',r.iss.length,r.iss.slice(0,4).map(c=>it(`data-gsa="ds|${esc(c.k)}|"`,esc(c.k),nf(c.n)+' kıymet',nf(c.f.size)+' fon')).join(''));
  h+=sec('Kıymetler / Ürünler',r.secs.length,r.secs.slice(0,6).map(x=>it(`data-gsa="ds|${esc(x.k||x.mk)}|${esc(x.g)}"`,esc(x.k&&x.k!==x.mk?x.mk:(x.mk))+(x.k&&x.k!==x.mk?' · '+esc(x.k):''),esc(x.g)+(x.iss?' · '+esc(x.iss):''),nf(x.funds.size)+' fon · '+fmtTL(x.tut))).join(''));
  h+=sec('Konkordato / Temerrüt',r.kon.length,r.kon.slice(0,4).map(k=>it(`data-gsa="kon|${esc(k[0])}"`,esc(ktAd(k)),esc(k[0]),nf(kFonSay(kHold(k[0])))+' fon')).join(''));
  h+=sec('Ödeme Takvimi (ÖST/ÖSB)',r.ost.length,r.ost.length?it(`data-gsa="ost|${q1}"`,esc(r.ost[0][1]||r.ost[0][0])+(new Set(r.ost.map(o=>o[0])).size>1?' ve diğerleri':''),'Genel Bakış’taki ödeme takviminde göster',nf(r.ost.length)+' ödeme'):'');
  d.innerHTML=h||'<div class="gse">Sonuç bulunamadı.</div>'; d.style.display='block';
}
function gsGo(v){ const r=gsData(v); if(r&&r.secs.length){ gsAct('ds',v,''); } else if(r&&r.funds.length===1){ gsClose(); const q=$('fl_q'); q.value=v; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); setPage('fl'); } else { gsClose(); const q=$('fl_q'); q.value=v; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); setPage('fl'); } }

/* ---------- TABLO DIŞA AKTARIM: Excel (.xlsx) ve PDF (yazdır → PDF olarak kaydet) ---------- */
const GEXP_NAME={ozYp:'yabanci_para_ozel_sektor_tahvil_bono_odeme_takvimi',ozOst:'ozel_sektor_borclanma_araclari_odeme_takvimi',ozOd:'tasfiye_temerrut_odeme_takvimi'};
function gexpBtns(id){ return `<div class="gexpb"><button class="ghost" data-gexp="${id}|xlsx" title="Tablodaki mevcut görünümü Excel olarak indirir">⭳ Excel</button><button class="ghost" data-gexp="${id}|pdf" title="Tablodaki mevcut görünümü PDF olarak kaydetmek için yazdırma penceresini açar">⭳ PDF</button></div>`; }
function gexpData(id){
  const g=GT[id], c=g.cfg(), st=g.st; let rows=c.rows.filter(r=>gtPass(c,st,r)); const sk=st.sort||c.defSort;
  if(sk){ const col=c.cols.find(x=>x.k===sk.k); if(col){ const key=col.sv||col.get, d=sk.dir==='asc'?1:-1;
    rows=rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>{ const x=key(a), y=key(b), nx=(x==null||x===''), ny=(y==null||y==='');
      if(nx&&ny) return 0; if(nx) return 1; if(ny) return -1; return (typeof x==='number'&&typeof y==='number'?x-y:String(x).localeCompare(String(y),'tr'))*d; }); } }
  const cols=c.cols.filter(x=>x.label);
  const fix=v=>{ if(v==null) return ''; if(typeof v==='string'&&/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(v)) return v.split('-').reverse().join('.'); return v; };
  return {head:cols.map(x=>x.xl||x.label+(x.type==='n'&&/Tutar|Nominal|Ödeme|Büyüklük/.test(x.label)?' (TL)':'')),cols,rows:rows.map(r=>cols.map(x=>{ return fix((x.exp||x.get)(r)); }))};
}
function gexpTitle(id){ const e=document.querySelector('#gt_'+id); const h=e&&e.closest('.card')?e.closest('.card').querySelector('h2'):null; return h?h.textContent.trim():(GEXP_NAME[id]||id); }
const crcT=(()=>{const t=[];for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xEDB88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;t[n]=c>>>0;}return t;})();
const crc32=b=>{let c=0xFFFFFFFF;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)c=crcT[(c^b[i])&255]^(c>>>8);return (c^0xFFFFFFFF)>>>0;};
function zipStore(files){
  const enc=new TextEncoder(), parts=[], cen=[]; let off=0;
  const u16=n=>[n&255,(n>>8)&255], u32=n=>[n&255,(n>>8)&255,(n>>16)&255,(n>>>24)&255];
  files.forEach(([name,txt])=>{ const nb=enc.encode(name), d=enc.encode(txt), crc=crc32(d);
    const lh=new Uint8Array([0x50,0x4b,3,4,...u16(20),...u16(0x0800),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0x21),...u32(crc),...u32(d.length),...u32(d.length),...u16(nb.length),...u16(0)]);
    parts.push(lh,nb,d);
    cen.push(new Uint8Array([0x50,0x4b,1,2,...u16(20),...u16(20),...u16(0x0800),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0x21),...u32(crc),...u32(d.length),...u32(d.length),...u16(nb.length),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u32(0),...u32(off)]),nb);
    off+=lh.length+nb.length+d.length; });
  const cl=cen.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.length,0);
  const end=new Uint8Array([0x50,0x4b,5,6,...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(files.length),...u16(files.length),...u32(cl),...u32(off),...u16(0)]);
  return new Blob([...parts,...cen,end],{type:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'});
}
function gexpXlsx(id){
  const D=gexpData(id), x=s=>String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
  const colL=i=>{let s='';i++;while(i>0){const m=(i-1)%26;s=String.fromCharCode(65+m)+s;i=Math.floor((i-1)/26);}return s;};
  const cell=(v,r,c,h)=>{ const ref=colL(c)+r; if(typeof v==='number'&&isFinite(v)) return `<c r="${ref}" s="${h?1:2}"><v>${v}</v></c>`; return `<c r="${ref}" t="inlineStr" s="${h?1:0}"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${x(v)}</t></is></c>`; };
  const rowsX=[D.head,...D.rows].map((r,i)=>`<row r="${i+1}">${r.map((v,c)=>cell(v,i+1,c,i===0)).join('')}</row>`).join('');
  const widths=D.head.map((h,c)=>{ let m=String(h).length; D.rows.slice(0,200).forEach(r=>{ m=Math.max(m,String(r[c]).length); }); return `<col min="${c+1}" max="${c+1}" width="${Math.min(48,Math.max(10,m+2))}" customWidth="1"/>`; }).join('');
  const sheet=`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"><sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"><pane ySplit="1" topLeftCell="A2" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/></sheetView></sheetViews><cols>${widths}</cols><sheetData>${rowsX}</sheetData><autoFilter ref="A1:${colL(D.head.length-1)}${D.rows.length+1}"/></worksheet>`;
  const styles=`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><styleSheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"><numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="#,##0.00"/></numFmts><fonts count="2"><font><sz val="11"/><name val="Calibri"/></font><font><b/><sz val="11"/><name val="Calibri"/></font></fonts><fills count="3"><fill><patternFill patternType="none"/></fill><fill><patternFill patternType="gray125"/></fill><fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFFDE7B0"/></patternFill></fill></fills><borders count="1"><border/></borders><cellStyleXfs count="1"><xf/></cellStyleXfs><cellXfs count="3"><xf xfId="0"/><xf xfId="0" fontId="1" fillId="2" applyFont="1" applyFill="1"/><xf xfId="0" numFmtId="164" applyNumberFormat="1"/></cellXfs></styleSheet>`;
  const wb=zipStore([['[Content_Types].xml','<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/></Types>'],
    ['_rels/.rels','<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>'],
    ['xl/workbook.xml','<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><sheets><sheet name="Ödeme Takvimi" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>'],
    ['xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels','<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/></Relationships>'],
    ['xl/styles.xml',styles],['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml',sheet]]);
  const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(wb); a.download=(GEXP_NAME[id]||id)+'.xlsx'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
}
function gexpPdf(id){
  const D=gexpData(id), x=s=>String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'), f=v=>typeof v==='number'?nf(v,2):x(v);
  const html=`<!doctype html><html lang="tr"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${x(gexpTitle(id))}</title><style>@page{size:A4 landscape;margin:12mm}body{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;color:#0f172a;font-size:9px}h1{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 4px}p{margin:0 0 8px;color:#64748b}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}th{background:#fde7b0;font-weight:700}th,td{border:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:3px 5px;text-align:center}tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#f8fafc}thead{display:table-header-group}tr{page-break-inside:avoid}</style></head><body><h1>${x(gexpTitle(id))}</h1><p>${x('5 Kasım')} itibarıyla · ${nf(D.rows.length)} satır</p><table><thead><tr>${D.head.map(h=>`<th>${x(h)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${D.rows.map(r=>`<tr>${r.map(v=>`<td>${f(v)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></body></html>`;
  const fr=document.createElement('iframe'); fr.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0'; document.body.appendChild(fr);
  fr.contentDocument.open(); fr.contentDocument.write(html); fr.contentDocument.close();
  setTimeout(()=>{ try{ fr.contentWindow.focus(); fr.contentWindow.print(); }catch(e){} setTimeout(()=>fr.remove(),4000); },300);
}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{ const b=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('[data-gexp]'); if(!b) return; const [id,k]=b.dataset.gexp.split('|'); if(k==='xlsx') gexpXlsx(id); else gexpPdf(id); });

</script>
</body>
</html>
